# Sub-linear scaling of bulk momentum with lid speed in the laminar driven cavity

Two converged mini-runs inside the validated envelope answered the hypothesis; the fidelity gate trusted the instrument for this QoI, and the run exits.

## Background

Benchmark cavity studies tabulate centerline velocity profiles and vortex intensities [R1] [R2].

## Hypothesis

Volume-averaged velocity magnitude scales sub-linearly with lid speed in the Re~100-200 cavity.

## Experiment Design

A two-point lid-speed sweep at fixed geometry and viscosity, one volAverage QoI per run.

## Results

0.417 m/s at lid 2.0 m/s and 0.193 m/s at lid 1.0 m/s; both runs converged.

## Discussion

The sub-linear scaling matched the prediction; triage none, decision exit.

## What Humans Must Validate

- No further human validation is required: the fidelity gate trusted the instrument for this QoI inside its validated envelope.
